sloka: तौ तस्य पादौ प्रदिशो दिशश्च गिरीन् गुहाश्चैव महार्णवं च।लङ्कां च सेनां कपिराक्षसानां विनादयन्तौ विनिपेततुश्च ।। ६.६७.१५१ ।।
transliteration: tau tasya pādau pradiśo diśaśca girīn guhāścaiva mahārṇavaṁ ca।laṅkāṁ ca senāṁ kapirākṣasānāṁ vinādayantau vinipetatuśca ।। 6.67.151 ।।

translations.english: "See my terrible club made of wrought iron. By this I have won earlier Devatas and Danavas."
